title: Full View: a user who can approve lines sees the 'Send to Portal' button
preconds: 1. A user has a role with View mode set to Full View, the Customer portal toggle ON, and Work order lines Create & Edit ON.
steps:
1. Log in as that user.
  2. Open a work order that has a line eligible to send to the portal.
  3. Find the Send to Portal button.
  4. Click it.
  5. Follow whatever flow appears (send confirmation, customer notification).
expected:
The Send to Portal button is shown.

Clicking it starts the Send to Portal flow.
